<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="bn">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>OFFICIAL JERSEY BD — Wear What The Pros Wear</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@600;700;800&family=Hind+Siliguri:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --purple:#4A154B; --purple-deep:#3F1D38; --lav:#F4F0F6; --lav-2:#E8E2EC;
  --gold:#FFB800; --ink:#2a1029; --muted:#6d5a6e; --white:#fff;
  --display:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',Impact,sans-serif;
  --body:'Hind Siliguri','Noto Sans Bengali','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:var(--body);background:var(--lav);color:var(--ink);line-height:1.6;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
img{max-width:100%;display:block}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:0}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.wrap{max-width:1160px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}

/* header */
header{background:var(--purple);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;box-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(63,29,56,.35)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:68px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--white);text-decoration:none}
.brand svg{width:42px;height:42px;flex:none}
.brand b{font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.06em;font-weight:800;line-height:1}
.brand b i{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.navlinks{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.navlinks a{color:var(--lav-2);text-decoration:none;font-weight:500;font-size:15px}
.navlinks a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
.cartbtn{background:var(--gold);color:var(--purple-deep);font-weight:700;padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.cartbtn span{background:var(--purple-deep);color:var(--gold);border-radius:999px;min-width:22px;height:22px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px;padding:0 6px}

/* hero */
.hero{background:var(--purple-deep);color:var(--white);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 0 46px,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 46px 92px)}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:40px;align-items:center;padding-top:64px;padding-bottom:72px}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(46px,7.5vw,92px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:.01em}
.hero .tag{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(24px,3.4vw,36px);color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;margin:14px 0 18px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.hero .sub{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--white)}
.hero .bn{color:var(--lav-2);font-size:15px;margin-bottom:12px}
.hero p.lead{margin-top:14px;font-size:17px;color:var(--white)}
.ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:28px}
.btn{display:inline-block;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;font-size:16px;padding:14px 26px;border-radius:10px;transition:transform .15s,background .15s}
.btn-gold{background:var(--gold);color:var(--purple-deep)}
.btn-gold:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);background:#ffc933}
.btn-line{border:2px solid var(--lav-2);color:var(--white);background:transparent}
.btn-line:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.duo{position:relative;height:430px}
.duo figure{position:absolute;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.duo .a{width:58%;left:0;top:30px;background:#fff;transform:rotate(-5deg)}
.duo .b{width:56%;right:0;top:0;transform:rotate(4deg);z-index:2;border:3px solid var(--gold)}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){.duo figure{animation:rise .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both}.duo .b{animation-delay:.15s}}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px) rotate(0)}}

/* shop */
section{padding:72px 0}
h2.title{font-family:var(--display);font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,52px);color:var(--purple);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;line-height:1}
.subtitle{color:var(--muted);margin:10px 0 36px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:28px}
.card{background:var(--white);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(74,21,75,.12);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.card .pic{background:var(--lav-2);aspect-ratio:1/1;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.card .pic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.card .body{padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;flex:1}
.card h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:28px;color:var(--purple);line-height:1.1;font-weight:700}
.price{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.price strong{font-size:30px;color:var(--purple-deep);font-weight:700}
.price small{color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.desc{color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.feat{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:6px;font-size:15px}
.feat li::before{content:"✔";color:var(--purple);margin-right:8px;font-weight:700}
.sizes{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sizes label{position:relative}
.sizes input{position:absolute;opacity:0}
.sizes span{display:grid;place-items:center;min-width:52px;height:44px;border:2px solid var(--lav-2);border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;color:var(--purple);background:var(--lav);transition:.15s}
.sizes input:checked+span{background:var(--purple);border-color:var(--purple);color:var(--gold)}
.sizes input:focus-visible+span{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.sizes.err span{border-color:#c0392b}
.sizelbl{font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.actions{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:auto}
.btn-add{background:var(--lav);color:var(--purple);border:2px solid var(--purple);padding:13px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
.btn-add:hover{background:var(--purple);color:var(--white)}
.btn-buy{background:var(--gold);color:var(--purple-deep);padding:14px;border-radius:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
.btn-buy:hover{background:#ffc933}
.actions small{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:12.5px;opacity:.8}

/* search */
.search{position:relative;max-width:560px;margin:0 0 32px}
.search input{width:100%;font:inherit;font-size:16px;padding:14px 48px 14px 48px;border:2px solid var(--lav-2);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(74,21,75,.08)}
.search input:focus{border-color:var(--purple);outline:none}
.search .ico{position:absolute;left:18px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:20px;height:20px;color:var(--purple);pointer-events:none}
.search .clr{position:absolute;right:10px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lav-2);color:var(--purple);font-size:18px;line-height:1;display:none}
.search.has .clr{display:block}
.nores{display:none;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);padding:40px 0;font-size:17px}
.nores.show{display:block}
.card[hidden]{display:none}

/* highlights band */
.band{background:var(--purple);color:var(--white);padding:44px 0}
.band .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
.band h4{font-family:var(--display);font-size:24px;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.03em}
.band p{color:var(--lav-2);font-size:15px}

/* checkout */
#checkout{background:var(--lav)}
.co{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
.panel{background:var(--white);border-radius:18px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(74,21,75,.1)}
.panel h3{font-family:var(--display);font-size:26px;color:var(--purple);margin-bottom:14px;font-weight:700}
.field{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px}
.field label,.legend{font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.field input,.field textarea{font:inherit;padding:12px 14px;border:2px solid var(--lav-2);border-radius:10px;background:var(--lav);color:var(--ink)}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--purple);outline:none;background:#fff}
.field .hint{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.opt{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;padding:14px;border:2px solid var(--lav-2);border-radius:12px;margin-bottom:10px;cursor:pointer;background:var(--lav)}
.opt:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--purple);background:#fff}
.opt input{margin-top:6px;accent-color:var(--purple)}
.opt b{display:block}
.opt em{font-style:normal;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
.opt .badge{margin-left:auto;background:var(--gold);color:var(--purple-deep);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;padding:2px 10px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
.sum{position:sticky;top:90px}
.line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--lav-2);font-size:15px}
.line.total{font-weight:700;font-size:20px;color:var(--purple-deep);border:0;padding-top:16px}
.line .rm{color:#c0392b;background:none;font-size:13px;text-decoration:underline;margin-left:6px}
.qty{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:4px}
.qty button{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px;background:var(--lav-2);color:var(--purple);font-weight:700}
.empty{color:var(--muted);padding:12px 0}
.btn-place{width:100%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--purple-deep);padding:16px;border-radius:12px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;margin-top:14px}
.btn-place:hover{background:#ffc933}
.msg{margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;color:#c0392b;font-weight:600;min-height:20px}
.ok{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--purple);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;margin-top:16px;display:none}
.ok.show{display:block}
.ok h4{color:var(--purple);font-size:20px}

/* footer */
footer{background:var(--purple-deep);color:var(--lav-2);padding:48px 0 28px}
footer .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:30px;align-items:center}
footer .brand{margin-bottom:10px}
.trust{display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:16px}
.trust a{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
.copy{text-align:center;margin-top:32px;font-size:13px;opacity:.7}

@media(max-width:860px){
  .hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-top:40px}
  .duo{height:360px;max-width:440px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}
  .grid,.co,.band .wrap,footer .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .sum{position:static}
  .navlinks a.hide{display:none}
  section{padding:52px 0}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="wrap nav">
    <a class="brand" href="#top" aria-label="Official Jersey BD">
      <!-- Logo -->
      <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" aria-hidden="true">
        <circle cx="32" cy="32" r="30" fill="#3F1D38" stroke="#FFB800" stroke-width="3"/>
        <path d="M20 16l8-3c1 3 3.5 5 4 5s3-2 4-5l8 3 8 7-5 7-5-3v22H22V27l-5 3-5-7z" fill="#FFB800" transform="translate(-0 0) scale(.82) translate(7 6)"/>
        <path d="M27 24h10v3H27z" fill="#4A154B" transform="translate(0 0)"/>
        <text x="32" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial Black,Impact,sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#4A154B" font-weight="900">BD</text>
      </svg>
      <b>OFFICIAL <i>JERSEY</i> BD</b>

    <nav class="navlinks">

      <a class="hide" href="#checkout">অর্ডার</a>

      <button class="cartbtn" id="openCart" aria-label="কার্ট দেখুন">🛒 কার্ট <span id="cartCount">0</span></button>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<main id="top">
<section class="hero" style="padding:0">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div>
      <h1>OFFICIAL<br>JERSEY BD</h1>

      <div class="ctas">
        <a class="btn btn-gold" href="#shop">গ্র্যাব ইওর জার্সি</a>
        <a class="btn btn-line" href="#shop">শপ কালেকশন</a>

    <div class="duo" aria-hidden="true">
      <figure class="a"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,





" alt=""></figure>
      <figure class="b"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,










" alt=""></figure>

<section id="shop">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2 class="title">প্লেয়ার এডিশন কালেকশন</h2>

      <svg class="ico" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-4-4"/></svg>
      <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="জার্সি খুঁজুন (যেমন: Real Madrid, Barcelona, বার্সা)" aria-label="জার্সি সার্চ করুন" autocomplete="off">
      <button type="button" class="clr" id="qClear" aria-label="সার্চ মুছুন">×</button>
    </form>
    <div class="grid" id="products"></div>
    <p class="nores" id="noRes">কোনো জার্সি পাওয়া যায়নি। অন্য নাম দিয়ে খুঁজে দেখুন।</p>
  </div>
</section>

<div class="band">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div><h4>প্রিমিয়াম ফেব্রিক</h4><p>সর্বোচ্চ আরামদায়ক ও ঘামরোধী কাপড়।</p></div>
    <div><h4>রেগুলার ফিট</h4><p>স্ট্রিটওয়্যার বা ক্যাজুয়াল লুকের জন্য পারফেক্ট।</p></div>
    <div><h4>নিখুঁত ফিনিশিং</h4><p>লং-লাস্টিং প্রিন্ট এবং প্লেয়ার এডিশন টপ নচ ফেব্রিক।</p></div>
  </div>
</div>

<section id="checkout">
  <div class="wrap">
    <h2 class="title">চেকআউট</h2>
    <p class="subtitle">আপনার তথ্য দিন, অর্ডার কনফার্ম করুন।</p>
    <div class="co">
      <form class="panel" id="orderForm" novalidate>
        <h3>শিপিং ডিটেইলস</h3>
        <div class="field">
          <label for="name">আপনার পুরো নাম (Full Name)</label>

        </div>

          <label for="addr">সম্পূর্ণ ঠিকানা</label>
          <textarea id="addr" name="addr" rows="3" placeholder="House/Road/Area, Thana, District" required></textarea>
        </div>

        <h3 style="margin-top:24px">ডেলিভারি অপশন</h3>
        <label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="ship" value="80" checked><div><b>ঢাকার ভেতরে (হোম ডেলিভারি)</b></div><span class="badge">৮০ টাকা</span></label>
        <label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="ship" value="140"><div><b>ঢাকার বাইরে (কুরিয়ার সার্ভিস)</b></div><span class="badge">১৪০ টাকা</span></label>

        <h3 style="margin-top:24px">পেমেন্ট মেথড</h3>
        <label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="pay" value="cod" checked><div><b>ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি</b><em>পণ্য হাতে পেয়ে টাকা পরিশোধ</em></div></label>
        <label class="opt"><input type="radio" name="pay" value="pre"><div><b>বিকাশ / নগদ প্রি-পেমেন্ট</b><em>অবশ্যই আগে পেমেন্ট করতে হবে</em></div><span class="badge">২% ডিসকাউন্ট</span></label>

        <button type="submit" class="btn-place">PLACE ORDER <small style="font-weight:500;font-size:14px">(অর্ডার কনফার্ম করুন)</small></button>
        <div class="msg" id="msg" role="alert"></div>
        <div class="ok" id="ok" role="status"></div>

      <aside class="panel sum">

        <div class="line"><span>ডেলিভারি চার্জ</span><span id="sShip">৳80</span></div>
        <div class="line total"><span>মোট</span><span id="sTotal">৳0</span></div>

</section>

<footer id="contact">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div>
      <div class="brand">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width="42" height="42" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="32" cy="32" r="30" fill="#4A154B" stroke="#FFB800" stroke-width="3"/><path d="M20 16l8-3c1 3 3.5 5 4 5s3-2 4-5l8 3 8 7-5 7-5-3v22H22V27l-5 3-5-7z" fill="#FFB800" transform="scale(.82) translate(7 6)"/><text x="32" y="43" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial Black,Impact,sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#4A154B" font-weight="900">BD</text></svg>

      <div>🔄 সহজ রিটার্ন ও এক্সচেঞ্জ পলিসি (শর্ত প্রযোজ্য)।</div>
      <div>📞 হেল্পলাইন / হোয়াটসঅ্যাপ সাপোর্ট: <a href="https://wa.me/8801792366969" target="_blank" rel="noopener">০১৭৯২৩৬৬৯৬৯</a></div>

  <div class="wrap"><p class="copy" style="grid-column:1/-1">© 2026 OFFICIAL JERSEY BD. All rights reserved.</p></div>

<script>
const WA = "8801792366969";
const PRODUCTS = [
  {id:"rm", title:"Real Madrid Home Authentic Player Jersey (Edition 26/27)", price:1100, kw:"real madrid madrid রিয়াল মাদ্রিদ রিয়াল white সাদা home", img:document.querySelector(".duo .a img").src},
  {id:"fcb", title:"Barcelona FC Home Authentic Player Jersey (Edition 26/27)", price:1100, kw:"barcelona barca fcb বার্সেলোনা বার্সা বার্সালোনা home", img:document.querySelector(".duo .b img").src}
];
const SIZES = ["M","L","XL","XXL"];
const bn = n => String(n).replace(/\d/g, d => "০১২৩৪৫৬৭৮৯"[d]);
const tk = n => "৳" + bn(Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US"));
let cart = [];

/* render products */
const grid = document.getElementById("products");
grid.innerHTML = PRODUCTS.map(p => `
  <article class="card" data-id="${p.id}" data-k="${(p.title+' '+p.kw).toLowerCase()}">
    <div class="pic"><img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.title}"></div>
    <div class="body">
      <h3>${p.title}</h3>
      <div class="price"><strong>${tk(p.price)}</strong><small>(ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি এভেইলবল)</small></div>
      <p class="desc">Player Edition টপ নচ ফেব্রিক যা আপনাকে রাখবে সারাদিন ফ্রেশ এবং কুল। নিখুঁত ফিনিশিং এবং লং-লাস্টিং প্রিন্ট।</p>
      <ul class="feat">
        <li>প্রিমিয়াম ফেব্রিক: সর্বোচ্চ আরামদায়ক ও ঘামরোধী কাপড়</li>
        <li>রেগুলার ফিট: স্ট্রিটওয়্যার বা ক্যাজুয়াল লুকের জন্য পারফেক্ট</li>
      </ul>
      <div class="sizelbl">সাইজ</div>
      <div class="sizes" role="radiogroup" aria-label="সাইজ">
        ${SIZES.map(s => `<label><input type="radio" name="size-${p.id}" value="${s}"><span>${s}</span></label>`).join("")}
      </div>
      <div class="actions">
        <button class="btn-add" data-act="add">+ ADD TO CART <small>(কার্টে যুক্ত করুন)</small></button>
        <button class="btn-buy" data-act="buy">BUY IT NOW <small>(শতভাগ নিশ্চিত হয়ে সরাসরি অর্ডার করুন)</small></button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </article>`).join("");

grid.addEventListener("click", e => {
  const btn = e.target.closest("button[data-act]"); if (!btn) return;
  const card = btn.closest(".card"); const p = PRODUCTS.find(x => x.id === card.dataset.id);
  const sel = card.querySelector("input:checked"); const box = card.querySelector(".sizes");
  if (!sel) { box.classList.add("err"); box.scrollIntoView({block:"center",behavior:"smooth"}); alert("অনুগ্রহ করে একটি সাইজ বেছে নিন।"); return; }
  box.classList.remove("err");
  addItem(p, sel.value);
  if (btn.dataset.act === "buy") document.getElementById("checkout").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});
  else { const c = document.getElementById("cartCount"); c.parentElement.animate([{transform:"scale(1)"},{transform:"scale(1.12)"},{transform:"scale(1)"}],{duration:300}); }
});

function addItem(p, size){
  const f = cart.find(i => i.id === p.id && i.size === size);
  f ? f.qty++ : cart.push({id:p.id, title:p.title, price:p.price, size, qty:1});
  render();
}

/* search */
const qEl=document.getElementById("q"), qBox=document.getElementById("searchForm"), noRes=document.getElementById("noRes");
function doSearch(){
  const terms=qEl.value.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  let shown=0;
  grid.querySelectorAll(".card").forEach(c=>{
    const ok=terms.every(t=>c.dataset.k.includes(t));
    c.hidden=!ok; if(ok) shown++;
  });
  noRes.classList.toggle("show",shown===0);
  qBox.classList.toggle("has",qEl.value.length>0);
}
qEl.addEventListener("input",doSearch);
document.getElementById("qClear").onclick=()=>{qEl.value="";doSearch();qEl.focus();};

/* summary */
function totals(){
  const sub = cart.reduce((a,i)=>a+i.price*i.qty,0);
  const pre = document.querySelector('input[name=pay]:checked').value === "pre";
  const disc = pre ? sub*0.02 : 0;
  const ship = cart.length ? +document.querySelector('input[name=ship]:checked').value : 0;
  return {sub, disc, ship, pre, total: sub - disc + ship};
}
function render(){
  document.getElementById("cartCount").textContent = bn(cart.reduce((a,i)=>a+i.qty,0));
  const box = document.getElementById("sumItems");
  box.innerHTML = cart.length ? cart.map((i,idx)=>`
    <div class="line"><div>${i.title}<br><small>সাইজ: ${i.size}</small>
      <div class="qty"><button type="button" data-q="-1" data-i="${idx}" aria-label="কমান">−</button><span>${bn(i.qty)}</span><button type="button" data-q="1" data-i="${idx}" aria-label="বাড়ান">+</button>
      <button type="button" class="rm" data-rm="${idx}">মুছুন</button></div></div>
      <span>${tk(i.price*i.qty)}</span></div>`).join("")
    : '<p class="empty">কার্ট খালি। উপরের কালেকশন থেকে জার্সি বেছে নিন।</p>';
  const t = totals();
  sSub.textContent = tk(t.sub); sShip.textContent = tk(t.ship);
  discRow.style.display = t.pre ? "flex" : "none"; sDisc.textContent = "-" + tk(t.disc);
  sTotal.textContent = tk(t.total);
}
document.getElementById("sumItems").addEventListener("click", e => {
  const q = e.target.closest("[data-q]"), r = e.target.closest("[data-rm]");
  if (q){ const it = cart[+q.dataset.i]; it.qty += +q.dataset.q; if (it.qty<1) cart.splice(+q.dataset.i,1); render(); }
  if (r){ cart.splice(+r.dataset.rm,1); render(); }
});
document.querySelectorAll("input[name=ship],input[name=pay]").forEach(i=>i.addEventListener("change",render));
document.getElementById("openCart").onclick = () => document.getElementById("checkout").scrollIntoView({behavior:"smooth"});

/* place order → WhatsApp */
document.getElementById("orderForm").addEventListener("submit", e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const msg = document.getElementById("msg"), ok = document.getElementById("ok");
  msg.textContent = ""; ok.className = "ok";
  const name = nameEl().value.trim(), phone = phoneEl().value.trim(), addr = addrEl().value.trim();
  if (!cart.length) return msg.textContent = "আগে কার্টে একটি জার্সি যোগ করুন।";
  if (!name || !addr) return msg.textContent = "নাম ও সম্পূর্ণ ঠিকানা দিন।";
  if (!/^(\+?88)?01[3-9]\d{8}$/.test(phone.replace(/\s|-/g,""))) return msg.textContent = "সঠিক ১১ ডিজিটের মোবাইল নম্বর দিন (01XXXXXXXXX)।";
  const t = totals();
  const lines = cart.map(i=>`• ${i.title} | Size: ${i.size} | Qty: ${i.qty} | ${tk(i.price*i.qty)}`).join("\n");
  const text = `নতুন অর্ডার - OFFICIAL JERSEY BD\n\n${lines}\n\nসাবটোটাল: ${tk(t.sub)}${t.pre?`\nডিসকাউন্ট (২%): -${tk(t.disc)}`:""}\nডেলিভারি: ${tk(t.ship)}\nমোট: ${tk(t.total)}\nপেমেন্ট: ${t.pre?"বিকাশ/নগদ প্রি-পেমেন্ট":"ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি"}\n\nনাম: ${name}\nমোবাইল: ${phone}\nঠিকানা: ${addr}`;
  const url = `https://wa.me/${WA}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`;
  ok.innerHTML = `<h4>ধন্যবাদ, ${name}!</h4><p>অর্ডার কনফার্ম করতে নিচের বাটনে চাপ দিয়ে হোয়াটসঅ্যাপে মেসেজটি পাঠান।${t.pre?" প্রি-পেমেন্টের ক্ষেত্রে আগে বিকাশ/নগদে পেমেন্ট সম্পন্ন করতে হবে।":""}</p><p style="margin-top:12px"><a class="btn btn-gold" href="${url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">হোয়াটসঅ্যাপে অর্ডার পাঠান</a></p>`;
  ok.classList.add("show");
  window.open(url, "_blank");
});
const nameEl=()=>document.getElementById("name"), phoneEl=()=>document.getElementById("phone"), addrEl=()=>document.getElementById("addr");
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
